title: Four Boston College Players Selected in NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Four Boston College Players Selected in NFL Draft
sources.description: Over the weekend, the Boston College football program had a surprisingly successful NFL Draft, as four players were selected from BC. It was the third-highest number of players from any ACC team, behind only Clemson and Miami, despite the team going 2-10 this past season. OL Jude Bowry selected by the Buffalo Bills, #102 overall […]
